newsitem.title: CHINA: Group forms for AMMB US$100 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Group forms for AMMB US$100 mln FRCD.

text.p: A group has formed for Arab-Malaysian Merchant Bank Berhad's US$100 million floating rate certificates of deposit issue due 2000, arranger Societe Generale Asia said on Friday.
The three-year certificates were priced at par to float at 25 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 29.5 basis points.
Arrangers, with US$19.25 million each, are DKB Asia, Societe Generale Asia, Development Bank of Singapore and Tokai Asia.
Co-arranger Norddeutsche Landesbank's Singapore branch committed to US$10 million.
Co-lead managers, with US$5 million each, are Baden-Wurttemburgische Bank and Sudwestdeutsche Landesbank's Singapore branch.
Manager National Bank of Abu Dhabi committed to US$3 million.
